# Feature Request: Add dark mode support

## Summary

Add a dark mode option to the application UI so users can switch between light and dark themes.

## Motivation

Many users prefer dark mode for reduced eye strain, especially when working in low-light environments.

## Proposed Solution

- Add a theme toggle button in the settings panel
- Persist the user's preference in local storage
- Apply CSS variables for theme colors

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] User can toggle between light and dark mode
- [ ] Preference is saved across sessions
- [ ] All UI components support both themes

## Additional Context

This is a commonly requested feature based on user feedback.
